notes: Basis: the paper defines P_ub as the probability that a star is unbound (T:p3-b6) and uses P_ub > 0.5 for HRS candidates (I:p3-b9). I therefore treat each included OUT or HRS star with tabulated P_ub > 0.5 as a retained Galactic-unbound candidate. GLHV-9, GLHV-14, GLHV-19, GLHV-20, and GLHV-23 are OUT entries with P_ub = 0.58, 0.79, 0.52, 0.64, and 0.92, respectively (I:p6-b0); the OUT row of Table 1 does not itself impose a P_ub cut, so this inclusion rests on their individual probabilities. GLHV-12, GLHV-16, GLHV-21, GLHV-22, and GLHV-24 are HRS entries with P_ub = 0.62, 0.63, 0.84, 0.98, and 0.96 (I:p3-b9, I:p6-b0). GLHV-13 is explicitly retained among the six HRS candidates (T:p4-b5, I:p5-b51), but its Table 3 P_ub is printed as 0.50 rather than >0.5 (I:p6-b0); I retain it because of the authors' final HRS classification and six-star count, and flag the threshold/rounding discrepancy. The 13 RS stars GLHV-1, GLHV-2, GLHV-3, GLHV-4, GLHV-5, GLHV-6, GLHV-7, GLHV-8, GLHV-10, GLHV-11, GLHV-15, GLHV-17, and GLHV-18 all have P_ub < 0.5 and are not treated as Galactic-unbound candidates (I:p6-b0). Table 1's P_MW inequalities appear inconsistent with the P_MW values in Table 3 (I:p3-b9 vs. I:p6-b0); I did not use P_MW for the unboundedness decision.

GLHV-9: Table 3 also lists P_MW = 0.42 for GLHV-9, but the paper defines P_MW as the probability that R_min,5Gyr < 25 kpc (T:p3-b10), not as the probability that the star is bound to the Milky Way; therefore it is not recorded as bound_probability. The unbound probability P_ub = 0.58 is recorded as reported.

GLHV-14: GLHV-14 (Gaia DR2 1002667880552099328) is listed under OUT candidates in Tables 2 and 3. The P_MW value 0.21 in Table 3 is defined in the text as the probability that R_min,5Gyr < 25 kpc, not as a bound probability, so it was not extracted as bound_probability. The table separately reports LAMOST rv_L, Gaia rv_G, and the adopted weighted mean \overline{rv}; all are retained with their respective conditions.

GLHV-19: Table 2/3 place GLHV-19 in the OUT candidates group, but Table 1 (T:p3-b9) requires P_MW > 0.5 for OUT candidates; Table 3 gives P_MW = 0.48 and P_ub = 0.52, which would satisfy the HRS criteria. I retain the listed values and the reported P_ub without reclassifying. P_MW is not one of the requested quantities and is not mapped to bound probability.

GLHV-20: Table 3 lists GLHV-20 under OUT candidates with P_MW = 0.36, whereas Table 1 states OUT candidates require P_MW > 0.5; this inconsistency is retained as reported (T:p3-b9, T:p3-b10, T:p6-b0). P_MW is not recorded as bound_probability because the text defines it as the probability that R_min,5Gyr < 25 kpc, not the probability that the star is bound (T:p3-b10). No parallax or proper-motion values for this target are present in the supplied material.

GLHV-23: For GLHV-23, Table 3 (T:p6-b0/I:p6-b0) also reports P_MW = 0.08. However, T:p3-b10 defines P_MW as the probability that R_min,5Gyr < 25 kpc, not as a bound probability, so it is not recorded as bound_probability. No parallax or proper-motion values are reported for this star in the supplied tables.

GLHV-12: The paper defines P_ub as the probability that a star is unbound after backward orbit integration (T:p3-b6) and gives P_ub = 0.62 for GLHV-12. Table 3 also lists P_MW = 1.00, but the text defines P_MW as the probability that R_min,5Gyr < 25 kpc (T:p3-b10), not as a bound probability, so it was not extracted as bound_probability. Radial velocities are reported separately as LAMOST rv_L, Gaia DR2 rv_G, and their adopted weighted mean.

GLHV-13: GLHV-13 is listed under HRS candidates in Tables 2 and 3, but its tabulated P_MW = 0.60 and P_ub = 0.50 do not satisfy the HRS criteria in Table 1 (P_MW < 0.5 and P_ub > 0.5); this classification inconsistency does not change the values reported above. P_MW is not extracted as bound_probability because the paper defines it as the probability that R_min,5Gyr < 25 kpc, not as the probability that the star is bound.

GLHV-16: For GLHV-16, Table 3 lists P_MW = 1.00, but the paper defines P_MW as the probability that R_min,5Gyr < 25 kpc (T:p3-b10), not as a bound probability, so it is not recorded as bound_probability. The separately reported unbound probability is P_ub = 0.63. No parallax or proper-motion values are reported for this star in the supplied tables.

GLHV-21: At T:p6-b0, GLHV-21 has P_MW = 1.00 and P_ub = 0.84. P_MW is not mapped to bound_probability because the paper defines P_MW as the probability that R_min,5Gyr < 25 kpc (T:p3-b10), not as a bound probability. No individual parallax or proper-motion values for GLHV-21 are given in the supplied material.

GLHV-22: Target GLHV-22 is identified as Gaia DR2 2629296824480015744. Table 3 (T:p6-b0) gives P_MW = 1.00, but the text defines P_MW as the probability that R_min,5Gyr < 25 kpc rather than a bound probability, so it was not mapped to bound_probability. The zero asymmetric errors on d and r_gc are reproduced as printed.

GLHV-24: For GLHV-24 (Gaia DR2 1383279090527227264), Table 3 reports P_MW = 1.00, but it is not extracted as a bound probability: the paper defines P_MW as the probability R_min,5Gyr < 25 kpc for classification (T:p3-b10), not as a probability of being gravitationally bound. The directly reported binding-related result is P_ub = 0.96, extracted as unbound_probability; its definition is in T:p3-b6. Three radial velocities are reported (LAMOST, Gaia, and weighted mean), so all three are retained.
